entities.summary: Geneva Accord, a significant document in the history of Afghanistan (1980–1992). Part of Soviet-Afghan War. Shaped Mujahideen Resistance and Soviet Withdrawal and US supplies Stinger missiles to mujahideen, shifting the air war.
